page.layout: One printed page, single column of text with a woodcut diagram (sun, moon, shadow cone, "VIA LVNÆ" and "EQVATOR LVNÆ") between the top line and the text below; no marginal notes; signature "S 3" at the foot right.

main_text.l: Si uero latitudinem habuerit in oppositione
in umbram incurret, tantoq; maior semper, quando
& latitu-do minor fuerit, & ipsa ad Eclipticam propius
Vt si latitudinem tanto minorem habuerit se-
semidiameter Lu-nae apparens, tota quidem intrà umbram conde-
tur, sed statim è regione se uicissim proferet in e-
superficiem um-brae stringet & praeteruehetur, ac dimidia globi

page.notes: Woodcut diagram: sun with rays at left, moon shown in phases, a cone of shadow pointing right, labelled "VIA LVNÆ" (above) and "EQVATOR LVNÆ" (below, inverted); stars at right. Catchword "pars" is printed at the lower right after "S 3". Printed text from the top line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Some letters in the top line are faded.
